fieldContext.note: Requirements tracing documents consistency between work products: Backward tracing links requirements back to system specs & standards; Forward tracing links requirements forward to design elements, code, test cases, and user manuals.

personalNotes: Impact Analysis footprint: Tracing system change -> software requirements -> design elements -> code units -> test cases establishes the exact work volume needed for a change.
